name: External Document Purpose 1 Code
definition: Specifies the document purpose as published in an external document purpose code list.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

CONF.name: Confirmed
CONF.definition: The document represents a document that has been confirmed, for example an invoice that has been confirmed by the buyer for payment.

FINV.name: Factoredinvoice
FINV.definition: The document represents an invoice submitted under a factoring arrangment.
